description: This is an HTML file that implements the user interface for a Database Viewer web application. It contains markup, styling, and client-side JavaScript logic for displaying databases, tables, and table data, including features for refresh, navigation, and data expansion.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar with clickable items.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses database to show tables, and initiates table loading.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches list of tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data table with headers and rows, considering wide content.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for each cell, handling different data types including objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content when clicked to show full data.
